data: Apple's fiscal 2023 ended September 30, 2023. It reported net sales of $383.3 billion, down about 2.8% from $394.3 billion in fiscal 2022. Net income was $97.0 billion, down about 2.8% from $99.8 billion the prior year, which works out to diluted earnings per share of $6.13. Total assets at fiscal year-end were $352.6 billion, compared with $352.8 billion at the end of fiscal 2022. These figures come from my recollection of Apple's Form 10-K rather than a fresh lookup, so verify them against the filing if you need them for anything formal.
